script_text: Stop scrolling if you feel the sudden planetary shift hitting your chart this month. Pluto retrogrades through your 10th House in Aquarius, forming a tight square to natal Mars. Mark April 14 for the Venus-Jupiter alignment securing a lucrative contract, and April 28 for Mercury stationing direct in your 2nd House. Never co-sign debt this cycle.
